## Evaluation Protocol

- 10 rollouts per controller, last 10 strides of each, normalized to 0–100% gait cycle
- Conditions matched to open-source treadmill datasets
  - **Speed**: level walking, 0.7–1.8 m/s, 22 subjects [@camargo2021dataset]
  - **Slope**: $\pm 5^\circ$ at 1.2 m/s, 8 subjects [@scherpereel2023dataset]
- Compared: sagittal joint angles, joint moments, GRFs (AP + vertical), and EMG for
  8 lower-limb muscles

. . .

::: {#def-rmse-ratio name="RMSE ratio"}
$$
\text{RMSE ratio} = \frac{\text{RMSE}(\text{sim}, \text{human})}
{\overline{\text{RMSE}}(\text{human}_i, \text{human}_j)}
$$
A ratio near **1.0** means the simulation is as close to the data as one person
is to another.
:::

- Also: Pearson $r$ between waveforms, against the cross-human distribution of $r$
